regions.title: Continuous adjacent detector selection
regions.equation: Choose adjacent detector groups at anchors 0,20,40,60,80,100; interpolate with t=(v-lo)/(hi-lo). Source field 0x18c. Above 100 the code instead uses index 0 and weight 0; do not infer out-of-range behavior as clamping.

regions.title: Nonlinear target-coordinate calibration
regions.equation: Object field 0x190 is clamped to 0..100, then interpolated through a five-point decreasing offset curve. Raw values withheld; curve coordinates 0,36,50,75,100.

regions.title: Rate-dependent adaptive coefficients
regions.equation: Two file-backed 14-word calibration records feed the setup. For positive F, step=1000/F; rate-dependent exponentials produce peak decay and two one-pole update coefficients. The attack increment factor is B*step/max(T,0.01); the reciprocal gain-dependence factor is 1/max(D,0.5). Record selection is controlled by a flag. F units inferred from sample-rate-like source field.

regions.title: Two-stage interpolation of peak and power in logarithmic units
regions.equation: Within each adjacent group blend floored 20*log10(peak) with floored 10*log10(2*power), using the selected calibration weight. Interpolate the two group levels, subtract 3.0103 dB and the control-dependent offset, then subtract the lookup origin (-70). The zero-input branch requires separate path validation.

limits: No vendor arrays or complete implementation exported. File-backed calibration values may be changed at runtime.
Numeric control fields are not proven APVTS/GUI parameter mappings. No real audio, CPU or VMR dynamics claim.
